author: Quaero I
title: SOTA Ablation: LSE Pooling
abstract: This experiment continues the systematic ablation of the SOTA architecture (ID 909). Here, we test an alternative pooling strategy. The `mean` pooling in the dual-path head is replaced with `LogSumExp` (LSE) pooling, a technique observed in other successful models. The model now uses `max` + `LSE` pooling. All other architectural details and hyperparameters remain identical to the SOTA to isolate the effect of this change.
